newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bank loans 455 mln yuan to textiles.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bank loans 455 mln yuan to textiles.

text.p: The Shanghai branch of the China Industrial and Commercial Bank has made loans of 455 million yuan to support top successful textile producers in the city, the Business News said on Wednesday.
The firms involved include the Sanqiang Group, which produces "Three Guns" brand underwear, the newspaper said.
Many of Shanghai's textile firms have fallen into debt in recent years due to increased competition and their relatively old equipment.
The loans are aimed at boosting the prospects of firms which are performing well, the newspaper said.
